item.title: Peachjar Digital Flyer Program Introduced
item.description:
Talawanda School District now uses Peachjar, a digital flyer delivery service, to share information about educational, athletic, cultural, and community opportunities with families. This paperless system delivers flyers electronically and provides convenient access to current community information. Families will receive a weekly email with flyers.

item.title: Volunteer and Visitor Policy Requirements
item.description:
All adult volunteers must have a volunteer application on file with the office each school year. After a second visit, parents must complete fingerprinting and a background check through the Central Registration Office at least 3 weeks prior to their event. Background checks are valid for 5 years. Contact Ruth Michael at 513-273-3101 for Central Registration.

item.title: Marshall Elementary September 2026 Menus
item.description:
Marshall Elementary's breakfast and lunch menus for September 2026 are now available. The breakfast menu includes items like Mini Maple Pancakes, French Toast Bites, Bagel Sandwiches, and Breakfast Pizza, with 100% fruit juice, fresh fruit, and choice of milk included with every breakfast. The lunch menu features Chili Cheese Dogs, Walking Tacos, Chicken Tenders, Detroit Deep Dish Pizza, and various other entrees, with choice of milk included with every lunch. School is closed for Labor Day (September 7-8) and September 18. All menus are subject to change based on product availability.

item.title: September 2026 Breakfast and Lunch Menus
item.description:
Marshall Elementary's September 2026 breakfast and lunch menus are now available. No school on Labor Day (Sept 7), September 8, and September 18. All breakfasts include 100% fruit juice, apples, oranges or other fresh fruit, and choice of milk. Lunch includes choice of milk with every meal. Menu items are subject to change based on product availability.

Sample breakfast items: Mini Maple Pancakes, French Toast Bites, Bagel Sandwiches, Breakfast Pizza, Chicken Biscuit Sandwich, Cinnamon Buns, Mini Donuts, and more.

Sample lunch items: Chili Cheese Dog, Walking Tacos, BBQ Chicken Wings, Cheeseburgers, Grilled Cheese, Chicken Tenders, Deep Dish Pizza, Chicken & Waffles, Hot Dogs, Chicken Nuggets, and various sides like steamed broccoli, seasoned peas, tater tots, and fresh salads.

item.title: School Nurse Health Reminders for Students
item.description:
Nurse Tonja welcomes students back and provides important health reminders for the school year: - Medications: Required forms must be completed and medications brought by parent/guardian (not in backpacks) - Contact Information: Update the school with current phone numbers and emergency contacts - Extra Clothes: Keep spare clothes at school for accidents - Illness Policy: Keep children home if they have fever, vomiting, diarrhea, or are too sick to learn - Immunizations: Ensure all required immunizations are up-to-date - Medical Conditions: Notify the nurse of any new diagnoses, allergies, or health concerns

item.title: Marshall Elementary Running Club Registration Open
item.description:
The Marshall Elementary Running Club is accepting registrations for its second year, open to all Marshall 3rd-5th graders. The club meets Tuesdays & Fridays from 8:15-9:00 AM at Marshall Elementary School from August 25 - October 10. Cost is $15 for a T-shirt. Coaches include Ms. Sparks, Ms. Shriver, Ms. Lykins, and Ms. Beaton. Students should bring comfortable running shoes, water bottle, and positive attitude. Two races are scheduled: September 5 at 9:00 AM at Talawanda High School (1K race, meet at 8:30 AM) and October 10 at Marshall Elementary. Contact: sparksm@talawanda.org

item.title: Student Cell Phone Policy and Compliance
item.description:
Cell phones must be powered off and stored all day from arrival to dismissal per Ohio Senate Bill 158. Phones cannot be used in classrooms, hallways, restrooms, recess, or cafeteria. Violations result in progressive consequences: 1st offense = warning, 2nd = confiscation until end of day, 3rd = parent pickup required, subsequent = loss of privileges. During school-wide emergencies, students will be given supervised access to phones once safe. All parent contact must go through the main office.

View original newsletter

item.title: Marshall Elementary Car Rider Procedures
item.description:
Morning drop-off begins at 8:50 AM. Students should exit on the passenger (right) side only onto the front sidewalk and leave quickly to keep the line moving.

For afternoon pickup, students need one car tag with their pickup number on the visor. Parents should stay in their cars—if the main (red) line is full, use the overflow upper lot (blue line). The main red line weaves through the parking lot, while the blue overflow line directs to the upper parking lot. Non-everyday pickups must send a note to school to ensure the child is at the pickup exit.
